values.features: • SMART FITNESS: Stride along with Sunny Health & Fitness expert trainers on the Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit® APP. Optionally connect your preferred mobile device through Bluetooth and view your performance metrics in real time (Smart version only). • SunnyFit® APP: The all new SunnyFit® APP takes your Sunny workouts to the next level! View your live metrics displayed in real time as you tour the world with real location maps. Get the results you want with customized workout plans. Explore 100+ workout videos that fits your schedule and goals. Compare your results on the elliptical leaderboard, share your fitness experiences, get workout tips and much more! • DIGITAL MONITOR: Measure and track your workouts more effectively with the onboard digital monitor which displays: Calories, Distance, Odometer, Pulse, RPM, Speed, Time and a Scan mode. • ADJUSTABLE SEAT: The comfortable, supportive, and adjustable seat is a welcome addition during those long elliptical sessions. It is 4-way adjustable and measures 10.6L x 9.4W x 2.8H in. • DEVICE HOLDER: Place your tablet, phone, or other mobile devices to stay connected. Follow along online with our Sunny Health & Fitness trainers for certified fitness tips, advice, and lessons. • HEAVY FLYWHEEL: Solid and sturdy, the 11 LB flywheel enhances your elliptical cross training workouts by delivering stability, smoothness and maintaining momentum. • MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Choose between 8 levels of magnetic resistance using the tension knob to provide multi-variable levels of resistance to your workout or fitness lessons. • PULSE SENSORS: Check your pulse rate safely at any moment during your workout with the handle mounted pulse sensors. • TRANSPORATION WHEELS: This indoor elliptical is not bound to one room after setup. Use the front-loaded transportation wheels to move this machine across several home surfaces.
